title: India Reaffirms Commitment to Dismantle Cross-Border Terror Ecosystem
detail: On the eve of the one-year anniversary of the Pahalgam terror attack (April 22, 2025), India's government issued a formal statement reaffirming its commitment to crush the 'terror ecosystem' that enabled the attack. The Indian Army issued a stern warning that India would not tolerate cross-border terrorism or allow terrorist infrastructure to be reconstituted. The government cited sustained operations in Jammu & Kashmir, ongoing counter-terror cooperation with partners, and strategic deterrence measures taken since Operation Sindoor as evidence of a new, more assertive posture. Officials signaled that India's position — that terrorism and normal bilateral relations cannot coexist — remains unchanged.

sources.name: DD News / News on Air (All India Radio)

media.caption: India reaffirms resolve to crush terror ecosystem one year after Pahalgam attack and Operation Sindoor
